yamlCheck.dateAnchor: The interrogation explicitly names DR 1748, but no month/day is spoken. June 9–20 comes from YAML, not transcript-derived dates.
yamlCheck.explanation: Retrospectively played downtime, earlier mirror work, initiation, two festival days and next-morning departure all belong to this session. The roughly seven-to-ten-day montage overlaps actor-specific activities and cannot establish an exact total. The initiation-to-first-morning transition and the two later next mornings are supported; dream and mirror history do not extend the adventure calendar. The narrated span can fit YAML’s eleven boundaries without supplying missing exact days from its endpoint.
